referenced_at: on~\ref{contr:approx}. The theorem holds for boundary data outside of the range of the EIT forward map. Data can leave this range for several reasons, including noisy measurements, discretization errors, or modeling errors. Our theory handles general worst-case perturbations and thus encompasses all three examples. The proof of \cref{thm:fno_approx_main} requires several steps, as illustrated in \cref{fig:flowchart}.
